phase_A1: [h/8,sin(pi*h/8),a/32]; envelope=tanh(h/8), fixed gamma=1; age enters MLP only
loss: fixed GT-only mask frame mean AbsRel + relu(frame mean AbsRel - detached current Cstar frame mean AbsRel) + 1e-4 * sum(delta_F^2)/clamp(sum(detached F^2),1e-12)
sample_order: 21 sequence x local-phase strata round-robin; within-stratum deterministic shuffled epochs; same order A0/A1
cache_dtype: preserve native dtype, FP16 if original FP16; no silent quantization
optimization: native C* state update retained; skip unused native depth projection on micro frames; compute transient readout for current output only
final_selection: fixed last update only; no validation checkpoint/phase/gain grid
timing: warm-file-cache RGB read/decode/preprocess/DIS/state update/micro readout/D2H/sync; no GT, metrics, residual diagnostics or state hashes
claims: development screening only; zero writeback is structural isolation, not zero output risk or a stability theorem; N14-B not auto-started
nonharm_hinge: frame-level relu(current mean AbsRel - frozen Cstar current mean AbsRel), same GT mask; not pixelwise hinge
bootstrap_unit: paired recordings; descriptive development CI, physical-scene independence not established
attribution: A0 vs A1 tests phase input + fixed envelope as one mechanism, not isolated contributions; both share safe hinge, initialization, sample order and update count
